name: Physical Formula Obfuscation
description: The previous polynomial constraint was vulnerable because symbolic math tools (like Sympy) could factor it into terms revealing $(s_u - s_v)$ as the only root. By replacing the polynomial with a procedural modulo arithmetic formula `(s_u^2 + s_v^2) % (s_u * s_v)`, we completely neutralize algebraic factorization. This formula mathematically evaluates to 1 for all distinct pairs and 0 for identical pairs, perfectly preserving the 3-coloring equivalence when the sum is forced to equal `m`. Models relying on static algebraic analysis will fail to recognize the graph coloring structure and will likely implement naive backtracking instead of degree-ordered heuristics, leading to a timeout.
